orchestrator.dependencies: Python standard library plus the checked-out instinctflash package

pi05.notes: Reference only. Other families keep their upstream-compatible driver environments isolated.

invariant.baseline_and_candidate: May use different interpreters, but each result must report a stable environment_fingerprint.
invariant.model: Every result must echo the exact locked model revision in its request.
invariant.dataset: Every request contains the exact dataset and asset revisions.
invariant.gpu: One plan process owns an exclusive per-GPU lock; jobs execute sequentially.
invariant.credentials: Never serialized. Tokens remain in the process environment.
